build_notes: If passed: add a nation strength score (population + weighted military value, excluding stockpiled resources/gold) and allow declaring on nations within 0.5x-2x of your score; keep new-player protection. Show the range on the wars page.
detail: Players are split: some want a range so big nations can't farm much smaller ones, others want no limits at all. Either way, new players keep 2 weeks of protection.
title: Should there be a war range, so you can only declare war on nations near your strength (strength based on population + military, not resources)?
